payload.name: wait-log
payload.description: Block until the authoritative event log advances, then append one compact observation receipt. usage: wait-log [after-seq] [timeout-seconds] [poll-seconds]; omitted after-seq snapshots the current maximum sequence. Prefer this over fixed sleeps while waiting for agents; timeout exits nonzero and appends nothing.

payload.name: wait-log
wait-log
payload.description: Block until the authoritative event log advances with a MATCHING event, then append one compact observation receipt. usage: wait-log [after-seq|-] [timeout-seconds] [poll-seconds] [filter...]; after-seq - or omitted snapshots the current maximum. Filters select what counts as an advance: name:<substr> by:<substr> goal:<substr> or a bare <substr> matched against all three — OR within a kind, AND across kinds. log.advance_observed receipts NEVER trigger a wake, so armed waiters cannot chase their own or each other's echoes. Prefer this over fixed sleeps and over unfiltered arming while waiting for specific agents; unfiltered wait-log in a busy multi-session instance wakes on every writer's noise. Timeout exits 124 and appends nothing.

payload.description: Block until the authoritative event log advances with a MATCHING event, then append one compact observation receipt. usage: wait-log [after-seq|-] [timeout-seconds] [poll-seconds] [filter...]; after-seq - or omitted snapshots the current maximum. Filters: name:<substr> by:<substr> goal:<substr> or bare <substr> against those three; review:<exact-id> stop:<exact-id> match only local testimony. OR within kind, AND across kinds. Sorted normalized filter receipts and goal summaries preserved. log.advance_observed NEVER triggers a wake, preventing receipt echo loops. Timeout exits 124 and appends nothing. Prefer exact review/stop filters for editor feedback and substring filters for existing agent workflows.
